purpose: Teach: 今年度/小規模/品目/原価/正社員/商社/同年/定例

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今年度、本気で、絶対、予算、絶対、確定しましょう
lines.en: This fiscal year, let's commit to finalizing the budget. Absolutely.
lines.style: Crisp and purposeful. Direct gaze. Sits forward slightly. Measured pace with clear emphasis on key commitment words. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、小規模、絶対、店舗、絶対、出店、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward seriously with our small-scale store expansion plans. Thank you for your commitment.
lines.style: Earnest and supportive. Nods as he speaks. Warm respect in the tone. Steady pace. Slight lift on gratitude—he means it, not rote.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 販売、本気で、絶対、品目、絶対、増やしましょう
lines.en: And let's expand our product lineup. We need to grow our sales offerings.
lines.style: Clear directive. Eyes move between you and the space ahead. Confident but inviting input. Slight emphasis on 'expand' and 'grow' without being aggressive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、原価、絶対、見直し、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've already reviewed our cost structure from the ground up. Thank you for the trust.
lines.style: Calm assurance. Relaxed shoulders. Speaks like someone who's already done the work and is proud of it. Quiet confidence. The 'thank you' lands with sincerity.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、契約社員、絶対、正社員、絶対、登用、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's also move forward with promoting our contract employees to full-time positions.
lines.style: Gentle conviction. Speaks with care—this matters personally. Slower pace, deliberate. Eyes steady. Not a command, but something she clearly believes in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大手、本気で、絶対、商社、絶対、と、絶対、商談、絶対、設定しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've already set up meetings with several major trading companies. Thank you for opening those doors.
lines.style: Steady and positive. Slight lean back—at ease. Says it like he's sharing good news. Warmth on the gratitude, brief pause before it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 佐藤さんと、本気で、絶対、同年、絶対、入社、絶対、社員、絶対、お祝い、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: And let's celebrate with Sato—he started the same year we did. He deserves that recognition.
lines.style: Warmer register. A smile in the voice. Slower, more personal. Sits back slightly. The words carry genuine affection and respect for a colleague.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、定例、絶対、報告書、絶対、簡素化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've simplified our regular reporting process to help everyone keep up. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Soft closure. Quieter, like wrapping up thoughtfully. A bit of relief in the tone—making things easier. Kind and direct. Lands like 'we're all in this together.'
